remarks: Welcome to this stunning 4 bedroom, 5.5 bathroom home nestled in the desirable Springdale section of Stamford, CT. Just steps away from a school.  One of the highlights of this home is the additional space of 800 sq ft, complete with its own private entrance.  This versatile area could be utilized as an in-law suite or provide comfortable accommodations for a live- in nanny or au pair.  With a spacious layout spanning 4293 sq ft, this home provides ample room for everyone. The kitchen is a chef's dream. You'll have all the space you need to create culinary masterpieces.  This home has been recently updated, ensuring a move- in ready experience. It's the perfect opportunity to settle in comfortably while you search or build your dream home.
